name: Tonari no MY Teacher
original_name: となりのMYティーチャー
source:
I awoke in the room by a sound from the next room. A beautiful lady had recently moved into the room. Her name is Kazama Midori, with glasses on her face. I got an itch when I thought of the new life with the next-door girl.
The next day, I found a shocking fact in my school.

[Edited From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ015219.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我在房间里被隔壁房间的声音吵醒。一位美丽的女士最近搬进了房间。她的名字叫风间绿，脸上戴着眼镜。一想到和邻家女孩的新生活，我就心痒痒。
第二天，我在学校发现了令人震惊的事实。

[编辑自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ015219.html]DLsite English[/url]]
